Fig. 3: Overview of the unified multimodal model. The frozen MLLM processes multimodal inputs and learnable queries. The DTR adaptively aggregates multi-layer MLLM hidden states based on distinct token semantics to condition the DiT. Furthermore, the optimized tokenizer serves as an internal alignment teacher, establishing a self-alignment paradigm that eliminates reliance on external learners.
Table 3: Evaluation of text-to-image generation on GenEval and WISE benchmark.

Fig. 2: Architecture of the semantic-pixel self-aligned unified tokenizer. Our tokenizer design explicitly decouples semantic preservation from pixel reconstruction. A lightweight semantic stream maps features into a compact latent space, strictly anchored by the frozen encoder to prevent catastrophic forgetting (Ls). Concurrently, a Transformer-augmented pixel stream bridges the dimensional gap by aligning with the native pixel latent space (Lp) to recover high-frequency spatial details. Both streams are fused and decoded to reconstruct the image (Lr), endowing the model with highfidelity generation capabilities without compromising its discriminative understanding.
